source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler), -enc UTF-8, raw and -layout modes; pdfplumber to check glyph size/baseline of sub/superscripts; pages rendered with pypdfium2 to check equation-font glyphs
source.notes: Genuine ISC 2018 board examination paper (Chemistry Paper 1, Theory, 862A) from the CISCE Archive Library bundle ISC-2018-Question-Papers-1.zip; the year comes from the bundle and the footer code 1218-862A on every page (recorded as paperCode). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Printed: Maximum marks 70, three hours plus 15 minutes reading time (not included in durationMinutes); 8 printed pages. No lettered sections are printed: Question 1 (20 marks: (a) 4×1 fill in the blanks, (b) 4×1 MCQ, (c) 4×1 matching, (d) 4×2 short answers), Questions 2-8 (2 marks each), 9-15 (3 marks each), 16-18 (5 marks each). Internal choice (OR) in Questions 2, 7, 9, 13, 16, 17 and 18, entered as (a)/(b) alternatives sharing a choiceGroup. The matching item 1(c) is split into its four 1-mark items, each repeating the column-B list; other questions whose sub-parts share one bracket are kept together. The text layer flattens subscripts, superscripts and charges and does not decode the equation font used in Q1(d)(ii) and Q16(a)(i); these were rebuilt in Unicode from glyph positions and the rendered pages and flagged per question. The data block on page 1 (gas constant R, 1 l atm, Faraday, Avogadro's number) is not repeated in the questions. The 2018 syllabus included topics (solid state, surface chemistry, metallurgy, p-block elements, polymers, chemistry in everyday life) that have no chapter in the current ISC list; those questions have chapter null.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
